story.meaning: Meridian's evidence corpus is broad and high-confidence in volume, but active coverage is only 55% — 224 candidate rows remain ungated, and critical platform, governance, and AI-audit evidence is explicitly absent.
story.observed: 500 total evidence rows; 276 active (55%), 224 candidate (45%). Confidence skews high (434 of 495 refs). Boundary markers are formally loaded, signaling that AWS/Databricks, medallion architecture, patient identity spine, data governance operating model, and AI audit trail are all unproven at this stage.
story.matters: Without closing the 224 candidate rows — particularly platform foundation, governance, and AI-audit evidence — none of the five priority use cases can advance from planning to decision grade. The evidence gap is the single gating constraint on Meridian's transformation roadmap.
story.supports: C-suite must authorize a structured evidence-closure sprint targeting medallion architecture, identity spine, governance operating model, transcript governance, and AI audit trail before any use case proceeds to sourcing or investment commitment.

findings: 87% of evidence references are high-confidence, but 45% of rows remain candidate-status — volume does not equal readiness; the gap is structural, not marginal.

All five priority use cases share the same upstream blockers: no certified medallion architecture, no patient/member identity spine, no formal data governance operating model — closing these three gates unlocks the entire roadmap.

AI governance and audit trail evidence is explicitly absent across all AI use cases; without HITL, model lineage, and audit logging evidence, FY26 AI spend cannot be governed or defended to regulators.

Interview evidence from 18 executive stakeholders is loaded and directionally consistent, but no stakeholder has signed off a decision-grade baseline — all interviews are preserved as planning context, not sourcing triggers.

Evidence gaps (medallion, identity spine, governance) → block Unified Clinical + Claims Lakehouse
Evidence gaps (governance model, semantic layer, AI audit trail) → block Governed Data Foundation for AI/LLM
Evidence gaps (transcript governance, intent taxonomy, member identity) → block Call Center Optimization
Evidence gaps (contract digitization, GL alignment) → block End-to-End Cost Transparency
Evidence gaps (SAS lineage, provider resolution, recovery workflow) → block Payment Integrity
relationships.note: The evidence dimension is the master gate: every use case, program, and budget dimension in Meridian's roadmap is contingent on closing the 224 candidate rows — particularly the six explicitly absent platform and governance foundations.
